'''Alternate Universe: Twilight''' is the 55th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on October 25, 2024. The set consists of 30 cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*3 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*1 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*1 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Cardassian)
*3 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*1 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*3 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*14 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (2 Bajoran, 4 Cardassian, , 2 Dominion, 2 Non-Aligned, and 6 Starfleet)
*1 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Starfleet)
*1 [[:Category:Tactic (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Tactic]]
*2 [[:Category:Time Location (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Time Location]]

'''NOTE:''' There are 2 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*30 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
